data.one_liner: Update the app badge on the launcher for iOS and macOS.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter applications to update or remove the badge count on the launcher for iOS and macOS platforms. It provides straightforward methods to set a specific badge count or reset it to zero.
use_when: You need to show unread message or notification counts on your app icon on iOS and macOS
You want a simple API to add or remove app badges imperatively
avoid_when: Your target platform is Android or other platforms not supported by this plugin
You need a comprehensive state-management or complex notification system
strengths: Simple and straightforward API for badge manipulation
Supports both iOS and macOS platforms
weaknesses: Non-iOS implementations were removed in version 2.0.0
Requires manual native setup including notification permissions on iOS
data.setup_notes: On iOS, notification permission is required and automatically requested, but you may need to enable Remote notification in Xcode or add UIBackgroundModes to Info.plist.
